column1: # Day 3 (第三日 唯一的通路) — SOLVED: MINOTAUR
# 1) 16 tiles (each 3x3 cells, fixed orientation) -> 4x4 -> a 12x12 maze.  Exactly one of
#    the 384 border-legal layouts is a PERFECT maze (144 cells / 143 open edges / connected
#    and acyclic), i.e. the green->red route really is the ONLY path.  See
# 2) Write this puzzle's six feeders, one after another, along the 55-cell path so that every
#    letter landing on a CORNER is the compass letter of the direction the path leaves that
#    corner in (N=up, S=down, E=right, W=left).  Over all 7 choices of which candidate feeder
#    to leave out x spaces/no-spaces x 720 orders, exactly ONE filling satisfies all 24 corners.
# 3) Read the eight yellow cells in path order.
# (DANGANRONPA is the one candidate NOT used here - it is day 2’s ☠️ feeder.)
